verdict.rationale: Plausible ships two documented APIs — the Events API for writing pageviews/custom events and the Stats API (v2 query endpoint) for reading historical/real-time stats — which covers a meaningful chunk of what the UI does. However, there is no evidence of API coverage for many UI-only features such as managing sites/teams, configuring funnels, goals, annotations, email/Slack reports, SSO, or data import/export, and probes show no OpenAPI spec or machine-readable docs exist. missing for 10: API parity for site/team management, funnel and goal configuration, annotations, report scheduling, import/export, and a published OpenAPI spec.
